source.repro: products/jbrowse-web: FIREFOX_NIGHTLY_PATH=... node browser-tests/probe-msaa-resize-cost.ts 60 4 --dpr=1|2 [--tracks=8] [--ceiling], headed Firefox Nightly 156.0a1 on a MacBook Pro 16" 2019 (Intel UHD 630 / AMD Radeon Pro 5300M, built-in Retina panel). `--dpr` pins layout.css.devPixelsPerPx, so both arms are the same window, the same track and the same driver, with the backing store the only thing that moved.
source.notes: MiB is width*height*4 bytes*4 samples, the size WebGPUHal asks createTexture for. The clamp row is not 4x because MAX_CANVAS_DIM_PX truncates it: at dpr 2 the backing store reaches 8192 at 4096 CSS px, at dpr 1 it takes 8192 CSS px. maxTextureDimension2D on this device is 8192 and maxBufferSize is 2147483644. Not published publicly: this is GPU bookkeeping a reader cannot act on, where the public page digests results someone tunes against.
